items.fdcDescription: Salad dressing, home recipe, vinegar and oil
items.notes: Manual semantic review binds Cook4Me 'Vinaigrette' to USDA SR Legacy 'Salad dressing, home recipe, vinegar and oil' through a retained exact evidence record. A vinaigrette is fundamentally an oil-and-vinegar dressing, so this USDA record matches the core ingredient identity without relying on the target's noisy local candidate search. Confidence remains medium because vinaigrette recipes vary in oil-to-acid ratio and may include mustard, herbs, sweetener, salt, or pepper; this decision does not generalize to creamy dressings, flavored commercial dressings, or unspecified 'preferred dressing'.
